greeting: You have something to say to me?
dialogue: Do you even know whose presence you stand in?
Try not to embarrass yourself in front of me.

taunts: Your lineage is so insignificant that even the heavens have forgotten its name.
Did your ancestors cultivate incompetence for ten generations?
An ant dares look upon this young master?
Elder! This fool needs a lesson in respect.
Your bloodline is weaker than the tea my servants discard.
